title: Closing the EFC Consciousness Bridge: Dimensionless, Scale-Invariant Unification of Entropy, Dynamics, and Awareness
abstract: Introduces a dimensionless, regime-indexed mapping from the EFC entropy field S to cognitive variables (Omega-hat, kappa-hat), derives coupled dynamical equations that make the Omega–kappa anti-correlation intrinsic, and replaces the separable product C=Omega*kappa with a single-parameter non-separable functional. The framework closes the cosmology-to-cognition bridge, inherits a cross-domain constant K=4.4±0.6 from SPARC rotation curves, and shows qualitative consistency with propofol sedation EEG.
